senses.gloss: to bring up, effect; to profit, accomplish. Y. Sot. VIII, 21ᶜ ולא הוֹעַלְתֶּם לעצמיכם כלום and you have profited nothing for yourselves; (Snh. 90ᵇ העליתם בידכם); v. זוּף I.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 24b:8">Erub. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>לחי מוֹעִיל וכ׳</he> a post helps (has the effect of making the moving about on the Sabbath permitted) for all vineyard paths. Ib. 25ᵃ <cite ref="E00001"><he>ה׳</he></cite> it does good (it serves its purpose).
<cite ref="Yoma 47a:13">Yoma 47ᵃ</cite> <he>ולא הוֹעִילוּ</he> and did not succeed (in obtaining distinction).
<cite ref="Megillah 6a:8">Meg. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>אינו מועילוכ׳</he> will not succeed in business.
<cite ref="Ketubot 10a:1">Keth. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>מה הועילו חכמים וכ׳</he> what have the scholars accomplished with their measure?; <cite ref="Gittin 17b">Gitt. 17ᵇ</cite>, sq.
Ib. 32ᵇ (if one said) גט זה לא יועיל this letter of divorce shall have no effect, contrad. to אינו מועיל has no effect.
<cite ref="Gittin 57b:10">Ib. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>תפלה שמוֹעֶלֶת</he> a prayer which was efficacious.
<cite ref="Gittin 65b:13">Ib. 65ᵇ</cite> (if he said, Write ye a letter of divorce and) <he>הוֹעִילוּ לה</he> make it of avail to her.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 100a:6">B. Bath. 100ᵃ</cite> <he>אין הילוך מוֹעִיל</he> walking through the field (as a symbol of possession) has no legal effect.
